Steps to unlock SoundCloud Go+ and Downloading Songs:

1.) Open SoundCloud
2.) Press and hold the Home button on the bottom-left corner of the tab bar.
OR tap the Messages 💬 icon on the top right, then tap NexaSC
3.) Tap Settings ⚙️ on the bottom
4.) Toggle on: Unlock Plus Subscription, Download Songs
5.) Tap the checkmark 🔗 icon on the top-right corner and click Restart Now
Steps to Download Songs:

1.) Play any song
2.) Tap the white Download icon ⬇️ to download the song
3.) Swipe down to exit the song
4.) Press and hold the Home button on the bottom-left corner of the tab bar. OR tap the Messages 💬 icon on the top right, then tap NexaSC
5.) Tap the downloaded song to play it
6.) Swipe down to exit the song
7.) Swipe from right-to-left on the downloaded song you want to export
8.) Tap Save to Files, choose where you want to save the song, then tap Save
